    uid=3_45 StaticText "Verification Organization A — Dashboard — Troop to Task"
  uid=3_46 dialog "What's New" modal
    uid=3_47 heading "What's New" level="2"
    uid=3_48 StaticText "SEP 26, 2026"
    uid=3_49 StaticText "LATEST UPDATE"
    uid=3_50 heading "Preparing for Future Improvements" level="3"
    uid=3_51 StaticText "Much of this update happened behind the scenes. We reorganized parts of the app and strengthened how existing features handle data to prepare for future improvements."
    uid=3_52 StaticText "This work also fixed bugs and closed gaps found while checking existing workflows."
    uid=3_53 StaticText "If something is not working as expected, use Feedback in the upper right to tell me what happened so I can investigate and fix it quickly."
    uid=3_54 region "Earlier updates"
      uid=3_55 StaticText "EARLIER UPDATES"
      uid=3_56 heading "Duty Rosters Will Return" level="4"
      uid=3_57 StaticText "Sep 22, 2026"
      uid=3_58 StaticText "The current Duty Rosters generation and history screens have been removed. Duty Rosters will return in a future update."
      uid=3_59 StaticText "Saved Calendar assignments, the Assignment Planner, and independent Sign-In Rosters remain available."
      uid=3_60 StaticText "Use Feedback to share what worked or what you need for scheduling."
      uid=3_61 heading "Duty Rosters Taken Offline" level="4"
      uid=3_62 StaticText "Sep 21, 2026"
      uid=3_63 StaticText "Duty Rosters was taken offline while bugs were reviewed. A rebuild was planned at the time; the feature has since been removed."
      uid=3_64 StaticText "Calendar and the Assignment Planner remained available."
      uid=3_65 heading "Organization Rank Catalogs" level="4"
      uid=3_66 StaticText "Jun 29, 2026"
      uid=3_67 StaticText "Organizations can now manage rank catalogs for joint-service ranks instead of being limited to one default rank list"
      uid=3_68 StaticText "Personnel imports can accept configured Navy ranks and other service-specific rank codes when they are active in the Organization catalog"
      uid=3_69 StaticText "At release, Duty Roster, Sign-In Roster, and Training rank workflows used pay-grade-aware ordering so cross-service ranks sorted together. Duty Rosters has since been removed."
      uid=3_70 heading "Clearer Organization Invites" level="4"
      uid=3_71 StaticText "May 23, 2026"
      uid=3_72 StaticText "Organization invites can now start the platform access request for new users, so invitees do not have to figure out that step on their own"
      uid=3_73 StaticText "Invite emails now explain when an access request has already been submitted on the invitee’s behalf and what happens after approval"
      uid=3_74 StaticText "Platform admins can see clearer invitation context during access review, including who sent the organization invite"
      uid=3_75 StaticText "Account access, organization invites, and owner/admin actions now have stronger protections against repeated attempts and may ask for extra identity confirmation when needed"
      uid=3_76 heading "Account Settings and Organization Exit" level="4"
      uid=3_77 StaticText "May 15, 2026"
      uid=3_78 StaticText "There is now an Account Settings page for managing account-level options outside of any one organization"
      uid=3_79 StaticText "Members can leave an organization from the account menu when they no longer need access"
      uid=3_80 StaticText "Organization owners are protected from accidentally leaving an organization they still own"
      uid=3_81 heading "A Fresh Look and Smoother Workflows" level="4"
      uid=3_82 StaticText "May 13, 2026"
      uid=3_83 StaticText "TroopToTask has a new look, with cleaner screens and more consistent controls across the app"
      uid=3_84 StaticText "Org Settings has moved to the top-left organization area so it is easier to find alongside organization-level controls"
      uid=3_85 StaticText "Training and Critical Task reports have been improved so readiness details are easier to scan and act on"
      uid=3_86 StaticText "The organization dashboard has been refined to make unit-level information clearer at a glance"
      uid=3_87 StaticText "Personnel rows now open a full Soldier detail page with readiness lanes, notes, counseling records, follow-ups, documents, and archived items in one place"
      uid=3_88 StaticText "Onboarding has been revamped with a smoother experience for tracking packets, progress, and next steps"
      uid=3_89 StaticText "Please report any bugs or issues you run into with the feedback button, or use it to share your thoughts on the new look"
      uid=3_90 StaticText "Several other quality-of-life updates are included throughout the app to make day-to-day work feel more polished"
      uid=3_91 heading "Duty Rosters Alpha" level="4"
      uid=3_92 StaticText "May 5, 2026"
      uid=3_93 StaticText "Duty Rosters Alpha launched in May 2026 as an early DA6 scheduling workflow. The feature has since been removed; saved Calendar assignments remain."
      uid=3_94 heading "Clearer Access Controls" level="4"
      uid=3_95 StaticText "Apr 23, 2026"
      uid=3_96 StaticText "TroopToTask now has more precise access controls, so leaders can give people access to the tools they need without opening up unrelated areas"
      uid=3_97 StaticText "Rating Scheme access is now managed on its own, separate from Personnel and Leader’s Book access, making permissions easier to understand and safer to adjust"
      uid=3_98 StaticText "Navigation and page access now line up more closely with each person’s assigned permissions, so users see fewer dead ends and fewer areas they should not be working in"
      uid=3_99 heading "Upcoming Loss Tracking" level="4"
      uid=3_100 StaticText "Apr 15, 2026"
      uid=3_101 StaticText "Personnel records now support ETS and PCS / DEROS dates, so upcoming losses can be tracked directly in TroopToTask"
      uid=3_102 StaticText "At release, People & Duty showed upcoming losses on the dashboard. The current dashboard still shows upcoming losses."
      uid=3_103 StaticText "Personnel approaching a loss date get a small badge next to their name on the personnel page, with an Ack Award button to clear the award reminder once it is being tracked"
      uid=3_104 StaticText "The goal is simple: catch upcoming losses early and avoid forgetting to start awards before people leave"
    uid=3_105 button "Got it" focusable focused
    uid=3_106 button "Close"
